outcome: Success rate of external cephalic version (ECV)
Mode of delivery after successful ECV
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent ECV at or beyond 37 weeks of gestation
finding: Women with persistent breech presentation experienced a high rate of ECV failure and a low rate of spontaneous vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Women with persistent breech presentation experienced a lower rate of vaginal delivery and a higher rate of cesarean deliveries compared to the nonpersistent breech presentation group.
